The current definition fixes the maximum product norm on X times Y, so closedness of the graph is now a well-typed topological assertion.

The reader result still made an impossible strict claim for T=0 and did not reach the constant needed downstream. The live theorem assumes T is nonzero and uses the symmetric points x+w and x-w to obtain the exact strict two-thirds bound from Sokal's argument.

The theorem retains the reader's correct dependency on uniform boundedness, and Alpha corrected the manifest routing error so that dependency is recorded on Banach-Steinhaus itself rather than as a self-dependency of uniform boundedness.
